description: Standardize error handling across controllers by creating a RespondsWithError trait and applying it to key admin controllers. Analysis report identified inconsistent error handling patterns: some use return back()->with('error'), some abort(), some throw exceptions. This feature creates a consistent API.
steps: Create app/Traits/RespondsWithError.php with trait RespondsWithError. Include method: protected function respondError(string $message, int $status = 400) { if (request()->expectsJson()) { return response()->json(['error' => $message], $status); } return back()->with('error', $message)->withInput(); }. Add a second method: protected function respondSuccess(string $message, ?string $redirectRoute = null) { if (request()->expectsJson()) { return response()->json(['success' => $message]); } $redirect = $redirectRoute ? redirect()->route($redirectRoute) : back(); return $redirect->with('success', $message); }

Update app/Http/Controllers/Admin/ContactSubmissionController.php to use the trait. Add 'use RespondsWithError;' at class level. Replace line 74 'return back()->with('error', ...)' with 'return $this->respondError(...)'. Replace line 106 'return back()->with('error', ...)' with 'return $this->respondError(...)'.

Update app/Http/Controllers/Admin/FileManagerController.php to use the trait. Add 'use RespondsWithError;'. Replace lines 103, 108, 113, 203 that use 'return back()->with('error', ...)' with 'return $this->respondError(...)'.

Update app/Http/Controllers/Admin/NewsletterCampaignController.php to use the trait. Add 'use RespondsWithError;'. Replace lines 58, 64, 119 that use 'return back()->with('error', ...)' with 'return $this->respondError(...)'.
Update app/Http/Controllers/Admin/SettingController.php to use the trait. Add 'use RespondsWithError;'. Replace line 93 'return back()->with('error', ...)' with 'return $this->respondError(...)'.
Add PHPDoc comments to the trait methods explaining usage: @param string $message, @param int $status (for respondError), @return \Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse|\Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse
acceptance_criteria: RespondsWithError trait created with respondError and respondSuccess methods
Trait correctly detects JSON requests via request()->expectsJson() and returns appropriate response
All identified admin controllers (ContactSubmissionController, FileManagerController, NewsletterCampaignController, SettingController) use the trait
Error messages remain unchanged (same text as before)
Existing functionality preserved (redirects back with error message in session)
verification: Run composer analyse and composer format:test
Run php artisan test - specifically tests/Feature/ContactSubmissionTest.php and any other admin controller tests
Manual: Test error scenarios in admin panel (e.g., upload invalid file, reply to contact without email) and verify error messages still display correctly
Manual: Test with Accept: application/json header and verify JSON error responses work
findings: Successfully created RespondsWithError trait with respondError() and respondSuccess() methods that automatically detect JSON requests. Applied trait to ContactSubmissionController (lines 74, 106), FileManagerController (lines 103, 108, 113, 203), NewsletterCampaignController (lines 58, 64, 119), and SettingController (line 93). All error messages remain unchanged. PHPStan analysis passed with no errors. Code formatting fixed with Pint. Note: ContactSubmissionTest.php failures are pre-existing and unrelated to these changes - they test the frontend contact form controller, not the admin controllers modified in this feature.
